about.headline: Building the circular economy's trading layer
about.subheadline: TheEndRyclecle is the operating system for global scrap and recyclables trading — connecting processors, brokers, and end-buyers across 52 countries.
about.missionBody: Every year, hundreds of millions of tonnes of recoverable material are mispriced, mishandled, or landfilled because the global market lacks transparent infrastructure. We exist to fix that — one verified shipment at a time.

transparency.title: Radical transparency
transparency.body: Every price you see is anchored to a public benchmark with the source disclosed.

compliance.title: Compliance by default
compliance.body: Sanctions screening, Basel conformance, and certified weights are built in — never optional.

circular.title: Circular by design
circular.body: Every tonne traded is a tonne diverted from extraction. We measure and publish our recovery impact.

contact.headline: Talk to a real trader
contact.subheadline: Our trading desk operates 24/5 from London, Singapore, and São Paulo. Average response time is under 4 hours.
